rows.corpus_definition: Coming from or related to a god.
rows.example_en: They believe the ancient temple is a divine place.

rows.corpus_definition: Being more powerful or important than others.
rows.example_en: He played a dominant role in the company.

rows.corpus_definition: Certain to have a bad ending or to fail.
rows.example_en: The project was doomed from the very start.

rows.corpus_definition: Creating a detailed technical plan or drawing.

The company had to take drastic action.

rows.corpus_definition: A very strong feeling of fear about something that might happen.
rows.example_en: I feel a sense of dread about the exam tomorrow.

rows.corpus_definition: When the sun or moon is hidden by another body.
rows.example_en: We watched the solar eclipse through special glasses.

rows.corpus_definition: The study of how living things interact with their environment.
rows.example_en: She studies ecology to save the local forest.

rows.corpus_definition: to fill someone with great delight or charm
rows.example_en: Her beautiful singing voice did enchant the whole audience.

rows.corpus_definition: A way to hide data so only certain people can read it.
rows.example_en: Modern messaging apps use strong encryption for privacy.
